contributionSummary: Restricts attendee, host, and positive manual merits to current configured org roles; preserves attendance and corrections, and serializes decision writes with finalization.

publicNote.description: Arbiter now awards event and staff-granted merits only to members with LGN, INT, or RES. Event reviews still show nonmembers’ attendance and explain why they cannot receive a merit, while checking membership again when the review is submitted.

commits.subject: fix(merit): require org membership for positive awards
